#check_failure Roth.approxSet_den_le_finite
namespace Bounded269Supplement
theorem finite_radius {K ι : Type*} [Ring K] [LinearOrder K]
    [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [FloorRing K] (s : Set ι) (hs : s.Finite) (c r : ι → K) :
    {p : ℤ × ι | p.2 ∈ s ∧ |(p.1 : K) - c p.2| ≤ r p.2}.Finite := by
  fail_if_success solve | exact?
  refine (hs.biUnion fun i _ ↦
    (Set.finite_Icc ⌈c i - r i⌉ ⌊c i + r i⌋).prod (Set.finite_singleton i)).subset ?_
  rintro ⟨h, i⟩ ⟨hi, hb⟩
  have hb' := abs_le.mp hb
  have hlo : c i - r i ≤ (h : K) := by
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using (le_sub_iff_add_le.mp hb'.1)
  have hhi : (h : K) ≤ c i + r i := by
    simpa only [add_comm] using (sub_le_iff_le_add.mp hb'.2)
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Icc, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  exact ⟨i, hi, ⟨Int.ceil_le.mpr hlo, Int.le_floor.mpr hhi⟩, rfl⟩

theorem zero_denominator_unrestricted :
    {p : ℤ × ℕ | p.2 ≤ 0 ∧ |(0 : ℝ) - (p.1 : ℝ) / p.2| < 1}.Infinite := by
  refine (Set.infinite_range_of_injective (f := fun h : ℤ ↦ (h, (0 : ℕ))) ?_).mono ?_
  · intro a b hab
    exact congrArg Prod.fst hab
  · rintro _ ⟨h, rfl⟩
    simp
end Bounded269Supplement
#print axioms Bounded269Supplement.finite_radius
#print axioms Bounded269Supplement.zero_denominator_unrestricted
